+"""Reusable record preparation steps."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from click.utils import make_default_short_help
+
+SHORT_HELP_MAX_LENGTH = 20
+
+
+def summarize(value: str) -> str:
+    """Condense help text using click's default short-help semantics."""
+    return make_default_short_help(value, SHORT_HELP_MAX_LENGTH)
+
+
+def validate_record(record: t.Any) -> tuple[str, t.Any, bool]:
+    """Validate a record and return its trimmed key, value and enabled flag."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+
+    key = record.get("key")
+
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value entry")
+
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+
+    return key.strip(), record["value"], enabled
+
+
+def prepare(
+    record: t.Any, display: t.Callable[[t.Any], t.Any] = summarize
+) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+    """Return a new prepared record; the input is never mutated."""
+    key, value, enabled = validate_record(record)
+    return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": display(value), "enabled": enabled}

@@ -41,3 +41,23 @@ def prepare(
     """Return a new prepared record; the input is never mutated."""
     key, value, enabled = validate_record(record)
     return {"key": key, "value": value, "display": display(value), "enabled": enabled}
+
+
+def batch(records: t.Any) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
+    """Prepare records in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+
+    prepared: list[dict[str, t.Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+
+        if item["key"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {item['key']!r}")
+
+        seen.add(item["key"])
+        prepared.append(item)
+
+    return prepared
